artifact_observations.reasoning: The embossed pattern on the paper forms characters that resemble text but are nonsensical and illegible (pseudo-script). This is a common AI artifact where the model mimics the structure of writing without understanding semantics.

Standard toilet paper typically has a geometric quilted or dotted embossment. Here, the embossment consists of complex, irregular raised shapes forming the gibberish text, which is physically unlikely for mass-produced tissue.
